sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Hydrating whole-fruit package. Water and whole-food structure make it easier to use well than juice or sweets. Ingredient simplicity is hard to argue with. Whole-fruit clarity is part of the category appeal.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: usually used in tiny amounts. That limits how much of the vitamin C and polyphenol upside you actually get per use. Easy to eat quickly when it is very sweet.
